property_summary: For any account and any existing token id, c.balanceOf(account, id) must return exactly the quantity of that id minted to the account; the mutant shifts the read slot by one, so after a mint it returns a stale/zero balance for at least some (account, id).
change_summary: Return the balance of the id shifted by one slot so balanceOf returns _balances[id + 1][account].
